name: Vanadium-based SCR catalyst (V2O5-WO3/TiO2), honeycomb/plate/corrugated forms
description: Vanadium-based SCR catalyst (V2O5-WO3/TiO2), honeycomb/plate/corrugated forms named on a page read in the GEG gap-fill for Diesel oxidation catalyst and SCR emission control system.

specifications.basis: Ye et al., 'Recent trends in vanadium-based SCR catalysts for NOx reduction in industrial applications: stationary sources', Nano Convergence 2022 Nov 19;9:51, section on SCR catalysts; CC BY 4.0 (value: V2O5-WO3/TiO2, typically 0.5-3 wt% V2O5 and 5-10 wt% WO3)
Same review, Table 1 'Operating characteristics of different SCR catalysts' (value: 260-425 deg C; most broadly used; 10-15 years of experience; sulfur tolerant)
Same review, Table 1 (value: 345-590 deg C; very high NOx conversion; very low NH3 slip; sulfur tolerant abov)
Same review, Table 1 (value: 150-300 deg C; narrow temperature window; not sulfur tolerant)
Same review, paragraph 'The SCR catalysts are divided into the three types: honeycomb, plate, and corrugated' (value: Honeycomb, plate and corrugated)
